fusions.name: Canopy Tongue
fusions.desc: A sticky lash from high in your branches that deals 4 damage and reaches 30% further. Anything struck moves 15% slower for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken Rain
fusions.desc: Shakes the rain out of your canopy, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, knocking them back 2.5 tiles and leaving them [Soaked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Rain-Rinsed Leaves
fusions.desc: Rinses up to 2 conditions off you. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Lodger in the Crook
fusions.desc: A bonded familiar lives in the crook of your branches and leaps at enemies within 5 tiles, striking for 3 damage and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a tick for 4 ticks.
